encoding.wire_order: big-endian: byte0 = keyClass (high byte), byte1 = keyId (low byte)
encoding.note: Keycodes are QMK 16-bit keycodes using the QMK >=0.19 numbering (layout matches the vendor enum Tu/keyClass values). Basic codes 0x04-0xA4 and 0xE0-0xE7 equal HID usage IDs.
encoding.source: index-D9yt26aK.js (deob) lines 13167 (enum Tu), 13176-13360 (KeyAction2 classes), 4533 (KC enum), 4537-5217 (label tables)

keyClasses.name: general
keyClasses.meaning: Basic keycode (see basic[]). keyId 0x01 = KC_TRANSPARENT ("Use the next lowest non-transparent key"), 0x00 = KC_NO

keyClasses.name: (QK_MODS)
keyClasses.meaning: QMK modifier+key: high byte bits 0x01 Ctrl, 0x02 Shift, 0x04 Alt, 0x08 GUI, 0x10 = right-hand mods; low byte basic keycode. NOT decoded by vendor UI (shows "Unknown"). UNVERIFIED

keyClasses.name: (QK_MOD_TAP)
keyClasses.meaning: QMK MT(mod,kc) = 0x2000 | (mod5 << 8) | kc. NOT decoded by vendor UI. UNVERIFIED

keyClasses.name: lt0..lt3
keyClasses.meaning: Layer-tap: kc on tap, momentary layer while held

keyClasses.name: layer
keyClasses.formula: TO(l)=0x5200|l, MO(l)=0x5220|l, DF(l)=0x5240|l, TG(l)=0x5260|l, OSL(l)=0x5280|l, OSM(mod)=0x52A0|mod, TT(l)=0x52C0|l (l = 0..31; this board has 4 layers)
keyClasses.meaning: Layer switching (QMK). The vendor locale has descriptions for MO/DF/TG/TT/OSL/TO. Sub-layout from QMK; UNVERIFIED

keyClasses.name: tapDance
keyClasses.meaning: Vendor advanced key slot implemented via Vial tap-dance entries (0xFE 0x0D ...). keyId <= 0x13 (i = 0..19) = MT (hold/tap), keyId >= 0x14 = TGL (toggle). RESOLVED from UI.

keyClasses.name: magic
keyClasses.meaning: QMK magic keycodes (swap ctrl/caps, NKRO toggle, ...). Individual values UNVERIFIED

keyClasses.name: programming
keyClasses.meaning: QMK joystick / programmable buttons / audio / steno

keyClasses.name: macro
keyClasses.formula: M(n) = 0x7700 | n (n = VIA dynamic macro index, 0..count-1)
keyClasses.meaning: Plays dynamic macro n (macro buffer cmds 0x0C-0x0F)

keyClasses.name: light
keyClasses.meaning: QMK lighting keycodes (see lighting[]); the UI offers 0x7820-0x7824, 0x7827-0x782A

keyClasses.name: kbAndUser
keyClasses.meaning: Vendor keycodes: 0x7E01-0x7E04 feature toggles, 0x7E05-0x7E18 DKS slots 0-19, 0x7E1A-0x7E21 side-light keys (NANO 68 only). See vendor[]. RESOLVED from UI.
